missing.why: Players may type her for Fate's Call, but it puts her Oathsworn ally into Stasis, never Kalista herself. Not missing.
Divine Judgment makes her Invulnerable but still targetable; the term excludes it. Not missing, but expect rejected Guesses.
Checked: the snapshot text for Sovereign's Domination and Heartbreaker never makes Viego Untargetable. Not missing unless the maintainer confirms an untargetable window while possessing in game.
Keeper's Verdict makes the knocked-back enemies Untargetable, not Poppy. Not missing.

disputable.why: Hallowed Mist only makes her Untargetable to enemies outside the zone (and never to towers); players inside can still click her.
The untargetable frame at the start of Hallucinate rests on an in-game label only; many players know R as a clone, not as untargetability.

aliases.why: Players type the surname as often as Tahm.

fun.why: Twenty answers across every role; most players name Fizz, Vlad or Yi quickly, but self-cast Stasis (Bard, Lissandra, Zilean) and Tahm's dive reward deeper kit knowledge.

champion:Fizz.why: Playful / Trickster is the textbook untargetable.

champion:Vladimir.why: Sanguine Pool is the other classic everyone cites.

champion:MasterYi.why: Alpha Strike dodging is widely known.

champion:Maokai.why: Twisted Advance's untargetability is rarely remembered now that the Rule no longer names it.

champion:Yuumi.why: Attached Yuumi being untargetable is a famous complaint.

champion:Zed.why: Death Mark dodge is well known among mid players.

champion:Xayah.why: Featherstorm is a known dodge tool, often listed with Fizz.

champion:Ekko.why: Chronobreak's untargetability is known but players think of the rewind first.

champion:Kayn.why: Umbral Trespass is untargetable; fairly well known.

champion:Lissandra.why: Self-cast Frozen Tomb is remembered by mid players.

champion:Camille.why: Players think of the hexcage, not the untargetable leap.

champion:Evelynn.why: Last Caress's backward hop is rarely framed as untargetable.

champion:RekSai.why: Void Rush's dive is untargetable, rarely remembered.

champion:Zilean.why: Self-Chronoshift Stasis is known, but players think 'revive' not 'untargetable'.

champion:Bard.why: Self-hit Tempered Fate is a known trick but a second-tier recall.

champion:TahmKench.why: Abyssal Dive is untargetable, but players think of the devour.

champion:Gwen.why: Hallowed Mist is usually described as 'can't be hit from outside'.

champion:Naafiri.why: Hounds' Pursuit untargetability is niche knowledge.

champion:Shaco.why: The Hallucinate vanish frame is very niche.

gemCandidates.why: Twisted Advance: he's a mass of roots mid-dash, so of course he can't be targeted. Strong reveal, and a few players know it.
Abyssal Dive: untargetable while underground; satisfying reveal.
Hitting himself with Tempered Fate is a known outplay; strong 'oh, right' moment.
